tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Young's inequality] ↗ def:convex-function-rn 1. appB:B.2-c\group Elementary Inequalities

Let $1<p,q<\infty $ and $p^{-1}+q^{-1}=1$. Then for $a,b>0$, \[ (6)\qquad ab\leq \frac{a^p}{p}+\frac{b^q}{q}. \]
Proof

\sketch Convexity of the exponential gives

\[ ab=e^{p^{-1}\log a^p+q^{-1}\log b^q} \leq p^{-1}e^{\log a^p}+q^{-1}e^{\log b^q}, \]

which is (6).

□
